title: Adopt the cf CLI where it serves ticfac best
description: Investigate, then implement, the best use of Cloudflare's unified `cf` CLI (beta, changelog 2026-09-28: one CLI for the public API and Workers projects, `cloudflare.config.ts` typed config, `cf migrate` from Wrangler; commands/config/build output may change before stable). Operator, 2026-10-01: cf is now announced as the wrangler replacement — move to it where it makes sense. Today the factory deploy depends on wrangler throughout: wrangler deploy (with the WRANGLER_DOCKER_BIN shim for registry logins + buildx cache, #147/#152/#161), wrangler containers info/rollouts (rollout wait, #144/#194), the image-preparation timeout retry (#195), secrets, D1 migrations, the staging Worker (umq/nmd), and agents' read-only wrangler calls. Scope: what cf covers of that today; a `cf migrate` trial on the staging Worker; which parts move (deploy, config, API reads) and which stay; then do the move. Gated on umq so the container migration lands first.
acceptance_criteria: [A1] A written decision: which ticfac operations move to cf, which stay on wrangler, and why (evidence from a cf migrate trial on staging). [A2] The parts that move are moved and a real deploy-factory run deploys through them. [A3] make gate + cloudflare suite green; AGENTS.md says which tool to use.
